note: Set B is preferred because it correctly identifies the Neutral Axes x3 coordinate as 0.0 m (visually on the axis), whereas Set A incorrectly claims 0.05 m and 0.02 m, creating an internal contradiction. Both sets struggle with x2 coordinates, assigning negative values to points in the positive x2 region, but Set B provides a more consistent set of claims without the redundancy and conflicting values found in Set A.
